verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a hosted customer portal that customers use to manage their own accounts. Merchants activate and brand it from the Dashboard, and it can be combined with Billing automations to cut manual customer interactions. A community comment also confirms the Customer Portal is part of Billing. Proration previews support plan changes, but the evidence never explicitly ties upgrade, downgrade, or cancel actions to the portal. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the portal handles upgrade/downgrade/cancel, embeddable components, independent hands-on corroboration of self-serve plan changes.
